protagonist: Quantum research software engineer; illustrative role, not a customer testimonial

scenes.title: The quantum research software engineer
scenes.subtitle: Detector counts → channel conventions → defensible analysis
scenes.narration: A quantum research software engineer turns detector counts into results a team can defend. Channel-mapping errors can change those results.

scenes.title: Same total. Different evidence.
scenes.subtitle: NVIDIA repair · Deliberately wrong operator control
scenes.narration: Two patches. Same total. One is wrong.

scenes.title: The total-only trap
scenes.subtitle: Synthetic Bell–CHSH case · protected pairwise checks
scenes.narration: Both repairs report two point six zero. But this deliberately wrong control changes every pair correlation. A total-only check misses the error. LabRepair compares each pair against protected inputs. All study data in this demonstration is synthetic.

scenes.title: A bounded NVIDIA proposal
scenes.subtitle: Nebius-hosted Nemotron · 121 input / 38 output tokens
scenes.narration: NVIDIA Nemotron, hosted by Nebius, proposed the valid channel correction. The real response used one hundred twenty-one input tokens and thirty-eight output tokens. Our adapter accepts two small parameter arrays and builds the source change. Input counts and protected tests stay fixed.

scenes.title: Three variants. One isolated operation.
scenes.subtitle: Recorded real Nebius Sandbox execution · 1.273 seconds
scenes.narration: We executed all three variants in one real, disposable Nebius Sandbox. The baseline failed. The NVIDIA repair passed all four checks. The wrong control was rejected. The operation took one point two seven three seconds, with guest networking disabled. You are viewing saved execution records.

scenes.title: The code passed. The claim did not.
scenes.subtitle: Corrected result 2.60 · Original claim 3.40 remains NOT REPRODUCED
scenes.narration: Now, the critical distinction. The repaired analysis computes two point six zero. The original claim was three point four zero. Passing the code checks does not reproduce that claim. LabRepair keeps both decisions separate, so accepting a repair cannot silently approve the scientific conclusion.

scenes.title: Keep the research decision explicit
scenes.subtitle: Local review intent · no cloud job dispatched
scenes.narration: The researcher can hold the review for more evidence. That decision is recorded with the reviewed source. It does not launch another job or overwrite the original claim.

scenes.title: A handover another researcher can inspect
scenes.subtitle: Source bindings · observed usage · actual execution outcomes
scenes.narration: The evidence handover preserves model usage, execution outcomes, source hashes and the rejected control. Another researcher can inspect what changed and replay the saved checks without a new cloud call. This is one bounded synthetic case, with its limits visible.

scenes.title: Repair the analysis. Preserve the evidence.
scenes.subtitle: Code repair: PASSED · Original claim: NOT REPRODUCED
scenes.narration: Code repair: passed. Original claim: not reproduced. LabRepair. Repair the analysis. Preserve the evidence.

evidence_boundaries: All study inputs are synthetic, not physical quantum measurements.
The wrong-pair control is operator-authored, not a second model generation.
Cloud results are recorded actual executions, not new calls during playback.
Editorial cards are labeled; UI screenshots and captured interaction frames are separate assets.
A successful bounded code repair does not establish quantum advantage or reproduce the original physical experiment.
No invented customer, revenue, loss, time-saving or broad benchmark claim.
